title: Siman 401
section: The Matter of the Opposition Against Him

segments.he: שָׁמַעְתִּימִפִּי הָרַב רַבִּי נָתָן זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה שֶׁאַחַר שֶׁאָמַר רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה מַאֲמַר תָּעִיתִי כְּשֶׂה
segments.en: (10.) He said: "All the great tzaddikim reached the level and standing they reached — but stopped there. And I, thank G-d, every single moment become a different person." And he gave the reason why they oppose him: for the tzaddik is called a tree — and has roots and branches etc. And every tzaddik before he reaches his level — there is opposition against him. For our Rabbis of blessed memory said [Sanhedrin 7a]: "This quarrel is like a breach in a dam" — so it turns out that the opposition...
